title: LedgerHeader whose scpValue is STELLAR_VALUE_EMPTY_TX_SET_MS: zero txSetHash, closeTimeMs in proposedMsValue
why: The protocol 30 form of the empty-set vote (CAP-0083 with CAP-0088 millisecond close times): ext arm 4 carries closeTimeMs next to the proposed set's hash, the previous ledger's hash and version. Readers that read closeTimeMs only from the SIGNED_MS arm fall back to whole seconds on these ledgers, and readers built before XDR 30 cannot decode arm 4 at all.

source.reason: the millisecond form of the empty-transaction-set value (protocol 30), built by stellar-core under the same multi-validator condition as STELLAR_VALUE_EMPTY_TX_SET; this is testnet ledger 5690456's header (protocol 30) with its signed_ms value rewritten as makeEmptyTxSetValueFromValue does: txSetHash zero, closeTimeMs kept, the proposed set hash, the previous ledger hash and version, and the original signature

notes: Built from corpus/objects/testnet/5690456 header, scpValue rewritten as makeEmptyTxSetValueFromValue does. The header hash of a real ledger with this value would differ; the bytes are checked by the oracle only.
